scores.title: Quantitative diagnosis
scores.desc: Every score shows its value, formula, version and confidence — no number without provenance.

coverage.title: Intent landscape
coverage.desc: Presence of the product in each relevant intent, the intent leader and the size of the gap (relevance × absence).

reco.title: Recommendations and competitive position
reco.desc_one: Distribution of the mention classifications across {{count}} observation and a comparison between the analyzed products.
reco.desc_other: Distribution of the mention classifications across {{count}} observations and a comparison between the analyzed products.
reco.distributionNote: Classification per Document 3, §27. “Irrelevant” falls outside the product scope.
reco.rankingNote_one: Ranked by Recommendation Share. {{product}} ranks #{{rank}} of {{count}} product.
reco.rankingNote_other: Ranked by Recommendation Share. {{product}} ranks #{{rank}} of {{count}} products.

evidenceLandscape.title: Evidence strength by intent
evidenceLandscape.desc: How much external evidence associated with the product exists for each relevant intent (scale 0–1). Values below 0.5 count as insufficient coverage.

gaps.title: Gaps identified
gaps.desc: Every gap carries the evidence behind it, its impact and confidence — no claim without backing.

raw.title: Observed raw evidence
raw.desc: Sample of the responses and sources that back the conclusions (Doc 4, §36).

evidenceTrace.title: How evidence becomes decisions
evidenceTrace.desc: Example of the highest-impact gap: from the observation to the recommended action.
evidenceTrace.hypothesis: Hypothesis: the missing association between the product and the intent topic may be reducing presence in responses.
evidenceTrace.action: Action: see “Opportunities & actions” for the prioritized intervention and validation plan.

opportunities.title: Prioritized opportunities
opportunities.desc: Each opportunity points to the gap that originated it and is classified by impact, relevance, confidence, effort and final priority.

actions.title: Recommended actions with traceability
actions.desc: Each action follows the chain observed problem → evidence → hypothesis → action, with validation defined. This is the opposite of an unsupported recommendation.

trace.title: Action → Opportunity → Gap
trace.desc: Tabular view of the full chain, for internal audit of the result.

cta.title: Run validation and re-audit
cta.desc: After 2–4 weeks of changes, run a new audit to compare presence, share and characterization.
